name: Achiri HTTP API — expose conversation handler as REST endpoint
goal: Expose AchiriConversationHandler as a standalone Express HTTP server. POST /chat accepts { userId, tier, message }, returns { reply, turns_in_memory }. Enables Telegram bot, mobile app, and web client integration. Runs as PM2 process achiri-api on port 3420.
rationale: Sprint 114 shipped memory. Gate date Apr 11. Achiri needs an HTTP API so real users (via Telegram or web) can connect. This is the bridge between the core engine and any front-end.
swarm: NOT USED — multi-file changes including large ecosystem.config.js. All tasks written directly.

tasks.title: agents/achiri/server.ts — Express HTTP API
scripts/achiri/validate-http-api.ts — endpoint validation
tasks.description:
Spawn the server in a child process with ACHIRI_DRY_RUN=1. Wait for it to be ready. Test:
  1. GET /health → status=ok
  2. POST /chat { userId: 'test-user', message: 'Aslema' } → has reply field
  3. GET /stats → has users and total_turns fields
  4. DELETE /memory/test-user → { ok: true }
  5. POST /chat missing message → 400
All 5 pass = PASS. Kill server after.
